# tinyalsa 1.1.1

Only `src/pcm.c`, `src/mixer.c`, `src/limits.c`, `include/tinyalsa/*.h` and `NOTICE`
from the release archive, unchanged. Used by `tablet/audio.c` (tb-audio) to play
sound on the tablet without Android.
